replays.query: what are the effects of a dog bite
replays.answer: If a dog bite pierces a person’s skin, bacteria from the animal’s mouth can get into the body and cause an infection. [1] Symptoms of a dog bite infection can include swelling and redness around the wound, pain that lasts longer than 24 hours, drainage from the wound, difficulty moving the affected part of the body and a warm feeling around the wound. [1] In some cases, an infection can spread to other parts of the body. [1] Apart from physical injuries, a dog attack survivor can also experience many lasting psychological effects such as post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD). [2]
